name: Budget - Property Comparison

parameters.name: property_visibility
parameters.description: The property visibility to filter by.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: The property filter. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. If required, you must submit an id for at least one of the below filters.

parameters.name: period_from
parameters.description: The 'Period From' month to filter by.

parameters.name: period_to
parameters.description: The 'Period To' month to filter by.

parameters.name: additional_account_types
parameters.description: Additional account types to filter by.

parameters.name: accounting_basis
parameters.description: The accounting basis to filter by.

parameters.name: level_of_detail
parameters.description: The level of detail to filter by.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Returns the specified columns. All columns are returned by default. Look at the response schema to see the available columns.
